title: Kardashian-Jenner Family Have Best Scouting Department In Sports And Entertainment, Says NBA Analyst
htmlContent:
Phoenix Suns point guard, Devin Booker was spotted recently with the Kardashian-Jenner Clan as they were celebrating Kim's 40th birthday on a private island.

"I surprised my closest inner circle with a trip to a private island," said Kim.

"There is not a single day that I take for granted, especially during these times when we are all reminded of the things that truly matter. For my birthday this year, I couldn’t think of a better way to spend it than with some of the people who have helped shaped me into the woman I am today," she wrote.

Devin Booker is currently dating Kendall Jenner and they have been together for some time now. In the past, Jenner has been linked to other athletes such as Blake Griffin, Ben Simmons, Jordan Clarkson, Chand﻿ ler Parsons, and Lewis Hamilton.

On Wednesday, during the closing segment of Jalen & Jacoby, Rose was asked if the Kardashian-Jenner association take down Devin Booker? As it has taken down so many athletes in the past?

"You know the Kardashian-Jenner family has the best scouting department in sports and entertainment," said Rose. "But, I'm rooting for D Book, so I feel and I hope he is the guy to break the curse."

What Rose is referring to is that athletes that have been linked to the Kardashian-Jenner clan such as James Harden, Lamar Odom, Reggie Bush, Kris Humphries, and Miles Austin, and Tristin Thompson careers have all suffered. During the time of their relationships with members of the family.
